request.subject: UNIT:CANDY:JUGGERNAUT

layers.text: Recolour only the crystals and change nothing else: the golem is built of rock candy in many colours, each big crystal chunk one colour: lemon yellow #ffe066, mint green #7fe0b0, amber orange #ffb347, sky blue #8fd3ff and white, mixed all over the body, each with lighter facets and white highlights; only one or two chunks stay pink. Keep the caramel brown bands and face, every shape, the pose, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
